people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?
translations.bsb: He has brought you near, you and all your fellow Levites, but you are seeking the priesthood as well.
translations.kjv: And he hath brought thee near to him, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood
translations.asv: and that he hath brought thee near, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee? and seek ye the priesthood also?
